note: One entry per detector, filled in before any of its results are ingested (plan.md section 7). Leave a field null if the vendor doesn't document it; never guess. score_meaning is what the documentation says the number means; calibrated is true only if the documentation says scores are calibrated probabilities.

desklib.name: Desklib AI Text Detector v1.01 (desklib/ai-text-detector-v1.01)
desklib.score_meaning: sigmoid probability that the text is AI-generated, the model's own output
desklib.notes: DeBERTa-v3-large fine-tuned on RAID; reported as leading the RAID leaderboard at submission

openai-roberta.name: OpenAI GPT-2 output detector (openai-community/roberta-base-openai-detector)
openai-roberta.score_meaning: softmax probability of the model's 'Fake' (GPT-2-generated) class
openai-roberta.notes: dated baseline trained on GPT-2 output; its card advises against using it on ChatGPT-era text or for misconduct decisions

fast-detectgpt.name: Fast-DetectGPT (Bao et al., ICLR 2024), gpt-neo-2.7B sampling and scoring
fast-detectgpt.score_meaning: probability from the authors' published normal fits of the sampling-discrepancy criterion for this model pair (local_infer.py), equal priors
fast-detectgpt.notes: the authors' weakest documented pair, chosen because it fits 8 GB; their falcon-7b and llama3-8b pairs are stronger

requested_but_not_run.ZeroGPT, GPTZero, QuillBot: hosted services with no downloadable model; GPTZero states it keeps a copy of submitted text, and the student corpora may only go to services that neither retain nor reuse submissions (sources.json). Running them needs the user's accounts; not done.
